seo.title: Marina de Saïdia: Restaurants, Walks & Tips | MoroccoTripMap
seo.description: Visit the Marina of Saïdia: modern harbour, seafront restaurants, evening promenade and the perfect base for a beach day near Oujda.
seo.og_description: Saïdia’s modern marina – boats, restaurants and a pleasant evening walk by the Mediterranean.

name: Marina de Saïdia
hero_subtitle: A large modern marina on the Mediterranean: restaurants, evening walks and the lively side of the Blue Pearl.

overview.title: The Modern Face of Saïdia
overview.p1: The Marina de Saïdia is one of the largest pleasure harbours on the Moroccan Mediterranean coast. It forms the heart of the modern resort area, with rows of boats, restaurants, cafés and a long promenade perfect for an evening stroll.
overview.p2: After a day on the beach, many visitors come here for a seafood dinner or simply to watch the light change over the water. The atmosphere is relaxed and holiday-oriented, a clear contrast to the traditional medina of Oujda an hour away.
overview.p3: It is also a practical hub for water sports and boat trips when available. Even if you only walk the quays and sit for a drink, the marina is one of the most pleasant spots in Saïdia.

s1.caption: Rows of boats in the modern harbour

moods.title: When to Enjoy the Marina
moods.subtitle: Best in the cooler hours of the day.

1.title: Quiet Quays
1.desc: Fewer people, soft light and a calm start before the beach gets busy.

2.title: Best Light and Atmosphere
2.desc: The heat eases, terraces fill and the marina becomes the social focus of Saïdia.

3.title: Dinner by the Water
3.desc: Ideal for a seafood meal or a long drink while the boats rock gently.

food.title: What to Eat at the Marina
food.p1: The marina is the easiest place in Saïdia for a sit-down meal with a view.
food.li1: Grilled fish and calamari – the local classic.
food.li3: Pizza, pasta and international options for families.
food.li4: Fresh juices, cocktails and mint tea on the terraces.
food.li5: Ice cream and desserts for an after-dinner stroll.
food.p2: Check the price of fish before ordering (often sold by weight). Service is generally relaxed and tourist-friendly.

1.title: Getting There
1.desc: The marina is in the heart of the Saïdia resort zone. From Oujda take a grand taxi to Saïdia (≈ 1 h), then a short local taxi or walk if you are already at the beach.

2.title: Parking & Access
2.desc: There is parking near the marina. In high season arrive a little earlier if you come by car.

3.title: Combining with the Beach
3.desc: Most visitors spend the day on the sand and the evening at the marina. It is a natural and easy combination.

q1.question: Is the marina free to visit?
q1.answer: Yes. Walking the quays and promenade is free. You only pay for food, drinks or activities.

q2.question: What is the best time to go?
q2.answer: Late afternoon and evening for the best atmosphere and light. Morning is quieter.

q3.question: Is it suitable for families?
q3.answer: Yes. The area is open, safe and has plenty of casual dining options.

q4.question: How long should I spend there?
q4.answer: 1 to 2 hours is typical for a walk and a meal. Longer if you stay for sunset and dinner.

q5.question: Can I combine the marina with the beach in one day?
q5.answer: Easily. Beach during the day, marina for the late afternoon and evening – the classic Saïdia rhythm.
